messages:
auditor_miller: Hi team — auditor here. For the SOC2 evidence package we need a clear mapping showing RBAC changes and KMS key rotations for the past 6 months, plus the logs that prove the change approvals and who performed them. Also need chain-of-custody for any keys that were retired and a cross-reference to any incident or vuln tickets. Can you list the artifacts you'll provide and a sample query we can run?

maria (sec-eng): Sure — high level: 1) RBAC change manifest (PR links + approvals), 2) IAM/cloud-role audit logs (who changed bindings), 3) KMS key rotation history & rotation schedule, 4) Key material lifecycle: create/disable/destroy events, 5) Incident/vuln crosswalk (ticket IDs), 6) Evidence manifest with hashed exports.

ajay: For RBAC: we can export rolebinding diffs from the infra repo and attach PRs. Also will include the CHANGELOG entries and the deployment windows.

sam: On vuln triage — we'll attach the Jira tickets and the triage notes showing whether any RBAC changes were related to the vuln. Link them by ticket ID in the manifest.

devops_oncall: For logs we'll provide CloudTrail (AWS) + KMS CloudWatch events. Sample CloudTrail query to show KMS operations: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 --start-time 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z``` That returns CreateKey/DisableKey/EnableKey/RotateKey events.

maria (sec-eng): Sample Splunk/SIEM query for RBAC changes (we'll provide exact saved search): ```index=cloudtrail eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters```. We'll include screenshots of the search results and the raw export (CSV + gz).

auditor_miller: Great — for chain-of-custody we need proof that retired keys were rotated and then scheduled for deletion with an approval record. What do you have for approvals?

maria (sec-eng): Approvals are recorded in the key rotation PRs in GitHub + the encrypted approval ticket in Confluence (signed off by Sec+Infra). We'll export PR diffs, signed approver usernames, and the Confluence page snapshot (PDF). Each artifact will include SHA256 hashes in the manifest.

ajay: Also adding the terraform plan/apply run IDs and the CI job logs that performed the rotation/deploy. That shows the actor and the commit. Example CI line we include: ```deploy-prod-rotation #5678 by ajay (hash: caf3...)```

sam: Linking incidents: vuln ticket INF-3245 triggered a temporary service-account deprov on 2025-11-12 — we'll include the incident timeline + remediation checklist that references the RBAC change PR.

devops_oncall: We'll stage the evidence bundle to S3: s3://redwood-audit-bundles/soc2/2026-03-01/kms-rbac-package.tar.gz and pre-signed URLs will be generated for the auditor team. Command to generate presigned link: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-audit-bundles/soc2/2026-03-01/kms-rbac-package.tar.gz --expires-in 604800```

auditor_miller: Perfect. One more ask — retention proof. We need to know the retention policy and that logs for the 6-month window are intact.

maria (sec-eng): Retention: CloudTrail logs retained in S3 for 2 years (immutable bucket with lock + versioning). SIEM raw event retention is 13 months, indexed events 2 years for SOC2 customers. We'll export a retention policy snapshot and the S3 object lock configuration.

sec_bot: Automated export job started: evidence-generator v2 kicked off by maria (sec-eng) at 2026-03-01T10:05:00Z — ETA ~15m. Job ID: eg-20260301-9bcd. Status updates will be posted here. :gear:

maria (sec-eng): ETA update — package uploaded, generating manifest + hashes, creating presigned links now. Expect delivery link in ~5m.

auditor_miller: Thanks — once you post the presigned link I'll validate the exports and run the sample queries. If we need further granularity I'll DM. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
